name: Kanungo Financiers Limited
about: Kanungo Financiers Limited is involved in the investment business in India. It deals in shares, stocks, securities, properties, bonds, and debentures; produces, exhibits, and distributes cinematographic films and talkies; and purchases, hires, or acquires films and talkies with the exhibiting, distributing, and renting rights. Kanungo Financiers Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
